verdict.rationale: Working Copy ships its own Repository Agent, a conversational AI assistant that can read and modify files, commit, pull and push. That covers the 'AI coding agent makes changes' core of the story. Nothing shows you can assign an issue to the agent, and nothing shows the agent produces a pull request; a separate doc line says the app can create 'these' for GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket, but the referent is unclear. Missing for 10: issue-to-agent assignment, agent-generated ready-to-review pull requests, asynchronous/background agent runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
